zh: 技能、插件与工具更新审核流收敛：管理员作为审核员直接维护与更新工具，无需提交审核；团队成员仅在本地完成副本更新后才展示「提交更新审核」按钮，提交前必须已在本地实际使用并完成深度体验确认。
Dragon 浏览器侧栏缩放体验与显示优化：修复网页缩放时产生的画面留白与排版问题，真实联动视口比例与页面渲染，提升远程页面浏览流畅度。
额度使用趋势曲线视觉精简与抖动平滑：全面移除连续曲线上的冗余交互圆点，保持线条丝滑纯净；优化重置时间戳的分钟精度对齐，避免服务商秒级抖动导致的曲线断裂。
en: Skill, plugin, and tool update review refinement: administrators act as reviewers with direct update capabilities and no redundant review submissions; team members only see the review submission button after locally updating their copy, requiring local testing and explicit confirmation before submission.
Dragon browser sidebar zoom & display optimization: resolved blank border margins during remote page zooming, accurately aligning viewport scaling and page rendering for smoother web inspection.
Quota usage trend line smoothing: eliminated redundant hover/endpoint dots on continuous curves for a clean and sleek line display, with minute-precision timestamp alignment against provider jitter.
